title: רב סמא בריה דרב אסי
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: Rav Sama son of Rav Assi spoke to Rav Ashi; some say Rav Sama son of Rav Ashi spoke to Rav Ashi, Ketubbot 33b. Menaḥot 25a: Rav Simi son of Rav Ashi to Rav Ashi. See Ketubbot 69a. He died in his father's lifetime, Rashi; see Zera Berakh on how Rashi knew this. Ravina collected for Rav Ashi's daughter from Mar son of Rav Ashi, etc., and from the son of Rav Sama son of Rav Ashi. He spoke to Ravina, Zevaḥim 19b, 24a; Bava Kamma 18a: Samya.
